concerns.text: FR-002 requires extracting fixation latency, and T004 computes it, but no task carries latency into the analysis: T005's aligned_data.csv column list (trial_id, participant_id, stimulus_id, roi_type, dwell_time_ms, first_fixation_prob, salience_score, luminance, contrast, excluded) has no latency column, and dataset.schema.yaml likewise omits it. The FR-002 latency metric is computed then silently dropped — add a latency column/task or an explicit exclusion decision.

T004 and the coverage table cite 'SCR-002' (weapons exclusion) and verify a file 'SCR-002-Exclusion-of-Weapons.md', but plan.md records only SCR-001; no SCR-002 exists in the spec/plan chain. This is a stale/unbacked tag: either the amendment must be recorded in plan.md/spec.md or T004 must implement FR-008 as written (Detectron2 weapons masks).

No task creates the pinned dependency file. The constitution requires 'A requirements.txt (or pyproject.toml) at code/ pins every Python dependency' and the plan's Constitution Check cites 'requirements.txt pins versions', but T001–T010 never produce it. Add it to T001 (or T010's fresh-environment run, which cannot be reproduced without it).

Plan Task Summary items T013a, T020e, T029c, T030b, T031, T032, T037, T039, T041, T042, T049 are covered by description inside consolidated tasks (T003, T004, T006, T010, T008), but T038 'Code Cleanup (Refactor and clean up code)' has no covering task or explicit disposition (unlike T044 which the plan marks Removed). State T038's disposition (subsumed/dropped) in the revision-behavior section.

FR-007 requires the 'correlational only' disclaimer on ALL machine-readable artifacts containing p-values < 0.05 (JSON, CSV). T008 applies it only to data/processed/results.json; data/interim/lmm_results.csv and lmm_results_fdr.csv (T006/T007) contain p-values but no task appends the disclaimer there. Extend T007/T008 to cover CSV artifacts.
